title: Simplest way to make variant metafield values available per line item on every new order?
text: We need each order to arrive in our downstream system already carrying some per-line-item data that we store as variant metafields . It has to work for every order origin: online store/headless checkout, draft orders, orders created via the Admin API, and subscription renewal orders created by Skio. We’d rather not query Shopify again per line when the order arrives. Since LineItem doesn’t support metafields and line item properties can’t be set after creation (see Metafields on line items? ), we went with this, and it works on a dev store: Flow, trigger Order created. A metafield alias created on order.lineItems.variant (unstructured, set up in a Log output step). Run code with input { order { lineItems { id variant { myAlias { value } } } } }, which builds a JSON object keyed by line item id. Update order metafield writes it as one json order metafield. Our app subscribes to orders/updated with metafieldNamespaces, and the update that follows the Flow write carries the metafield. Questions : Is this the simplest supported approach, or is there a more direct way to get variant-level data onto a new order (or into its webhook payload) for all order origins? Is aliasing a metafield on a nested list element (lineItems.variant) officially supported in Run code, or does it just happen to work? What delivery guarantees does Flow give for Order created ? Is it guaranteed to run for every order, and does it retry? We want to know whether we need our own reconciliation for orders that never get the metafield. Does Order created fire for subscription renewal orders created by a third-party subscription app like Skio (via subscription billing attempts)? Is there anything about those orders that would stop the Run code input from resolving the variant metafields? 2 posts - 2 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: Needs variant metafields available per line item on every order.

title: Urgent Concern Regarding Withdrawal Denial, Account Closure, and Lack of Customer Support
text: I am extremely frustrated and concerned about my experience with Alpaca Markets. I have been trying to contact Alpaca regarding the denial of my withdrawal request and the closure of my brokerage account. Unfortunately, Alpaca does not appear to offer access to a live customer support representative or a customer service phone number. I have submitted multiple support tickets but have yet to receive a meaningful response or resolution. Their Zendesk support system repeatedly provides generic, scripted responses that fail to address my specific concerns. This lack of personalized customer support is unacceptable, especially for a financial institution responsible for safeguarding customers’ investments and cash. My biggest concern is the safety of my funds. With my withdrawal request denied, my account being closed, and no effective way to communicate directly with a representative, I am genuinely worried about whether I will be able to recover my money. How can I speak directly with a real person at Alpaca Markets rather than continuing to send emails to support@alpaca.markets ? As a brokerage firm handling customers’ hard-earned money, Alpaca should provide a reliable way for customers to resolve urgent financial matters. I would appreciate any guidance on how to escalate this issue to Alpaca’s management or compliance department. Customers should not have to struggle to access their own money or receive basic customer support from a brokerage firm. 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic
triage_reason: Brokerage customer facing denied withdrawal and closed account without support.
